answer_1.quote: We evaluate the models' ability to explain why a given video is funny as a measure of understanding video humor ... we generate explanations ... using T5, BART, and GPT-3.5.
answer_1.outputs: Text explanations of funny moments (up to three sentences per video)

answer_2.quote: We evaluate explanations using two model-based scores: SentBERT Score and ROSCOE ... We also compute rationale quality scores via a moment localization task using IoU thresholds.

answer_4.quote: We employ 10 AMT workers ... to rate each explanation according to No (0), Weak No (0.25), Neutral (0.5), Weak Yes (0.75), and Yes (1).
answer_4.guideline: Workers assign a rating on a five‑point scale (No, Weak No, Neutral, Weak Yes, Yes) to each generated explanation.
